mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 62 degrees and overcast conditions near Badger Ridge Middle School. The Waning Gibbous moon is out tonight, and we are looking at an overnight low of 47 degrees with no rain predicted.

October has been proclaimed Community Planning Month to highlight our department's hard work. Additionally, the city is reminding residents to watch for letters regarding mandatory cross-connection control surveys to keep our water supply clean.

Today, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, a happy hour at ART House 360, or trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, plus the Dane County Farmer's Market this Saturday.
On September 21, a retail theft incident occurred involving the theft of candy from a retailer on East Verona Avenue, leading officers to identify and cite the individual responsible.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch. The Verona location is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:00 PM tonight.
